communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Oath of office for Sheriff in office from 2022-2026
2. Drone contract,(remotely piloted vehicles (RPVs), remotely piloted aircraft (RPAs), unmanned aerials (UAs), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and/or unmanned aerial systems (UASs)(hereinafter “drones”), use, data collected, database used, permits  & licenses, insurance coverage, and what entities are privy to gaining access to drone footage. In what situation are Aerial Drones deployed? Please include the safeguards used to protect individuals and real property privacy during drone deployment.
3. Flock contract, data collected, database used, permits.
4. Internal documents on the approval of ALPR technology, Aerial drones.
5. Invoices for Flock and aerial drone technologies.
6. Identify all agencies that have access to Sauk County 's Flock cameras.
7.Policies related to the adoption of ALPR technology, including those guiding the procurement process or necessary administrative obligations before acquisition.
8. Training policies, requirements, and materials for automatic license plate reader system operators.
9.Training policies, requirements, and materials for aerial drones
10. Databases used to compare data obtained by the automatic license plate reader system.
11. Policies related to the retention and security of captured ALPR data, including those regarding:
- the length of time after capture that data may be preserved
- exceptions to general data preservation policies
- internal data security and access
- data destruction
-requests to remove data 
12. Policies related to the sharing of captured ALPR data by this agency with other agencies, including those directing:
- the manner in which another agency may request data
- the circumstances under which captured data may be shared, and
- the responsibilities of the recipient agency in regards to data retention and use.
- access by this agency to data obtained by automatic license plate reader systems not operated by the law enforcement agency.
13.Please also provide the number of requests made by outside agencies from January 2023 thru 9-10-2026.
14.Policies related to the sale of data or the sharing of data with non-law enforcement actors.
- If applicable, please provide all agreements between this agency and non-law enforcement actors.
15. Policies regarding oversight of automatic license plate reader system use as well as the drone policy.
16. Audit Reports
17. Policies related to maintenance and calibration.Please also provide maintenance and calibration schedules and records for the system on file.
18. Any other policies or reports on subjects related to automatic license plate reader system and aerial drone use by the agency.
19. The number of scanned license plates collected from first camera deployment  thru 9-10-2026
20. The number of arrests made in result of the ALPR data or the Aerial Drone data. Of said arrests, what were the types of crimes committed?
21. If the procurement of ALPR /Flock cameras and Aerial Drone was received as part of a grant, please provide the grant documents. If they were acquired as a donation, please identify the donor.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as I believe this request is in the public interest. The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Sara Rogers
